Chrome Built-in AI Not Available

This feature requires Chrome 127+ with the built-in AI flag enabled.

How to enable:

  1. Open Chrome 127 or later (check: chrome://version)
  2. Go to chrome://flags/#optimization-guide-on-device-model
  3. Set to "Enabled BypassPerfRequirement"
  4. Go to chrome://flags/#prompt-api-for-gemini-nano
  5. Set to "Enabled"
  6. Restart Chrome and wait for the model to download (~1.7GB)
  7. Check status at chrome://components → "Optimization Guide On Device Model"
💡 Why local AI? Your financial data never leaves your device. No API keys, no cloud costs, no privacy concerns. All processing happens on-device using Chrome's built-in Gemini Nano model.
